lyrics.text: 疾风掠过绯色长街，心跳加速突破音障
lyrics.sub_text: Gale sweeps the crimson avenue as heartbeats break sound

lyrics.text: 碎拍鼓点如骤雨倾落，化作指尖金色闪电
lyrics.sub_text: Breakbeat rain cascades into golden lightning at your fingers

lyrics.text: 不留退路全速推进，冲破镜花构筑的迷宫
lyrics.sub_text: Full-throttle ahead, shattering the labyrinth of mirror blooms

lyrics.text: 极速尽头唯有澄明，见证属于胜者的拂晓
lyrics.sub_text: Beyond top speed lies clarity and the dawn of victors
